content.text: Here are two for the weekend. Central Library story time is at the Bloor/Gladstone branch on Sat, Aug 8. It's an indoor drop-in and all ages are welcome. [link-c9bfa2] Riverdale Farm is on Sun, Aug 9. It's an outdoor farm and open daily. [link-b8b9f6] Saturday is forecast to be hot and dry. Do you want me to put one on the calendar?
